title.purpose: Step titles and the truck aside heading.

numeral.purpose: Roman step numerals in brass numeral.

wordmark.purpose: Uppercase serif name in header and footer only.

label.purpose: Action word inside call buttons only.

phone.purpose: The number inside call buttons, tabular.

shadows.name: pane
shadows.purpose: Every light glass surface, including the header bar: diffuse inner thickness shading plus a long green ambient shadow.

glass.name: backdrop
glass.purpose: backdrop-filter on every light pane and the header bar.

glass.name: fill
glass.purpose: Pane fill when backdrop-filter is supported.

glass.name: fill-fallback
glass.purpose: More opaque fill when backdrop-filter is unsupported, so contrast holds.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: No transitions or animations anywhere. State changes are instant (older audience, Still Glass Rule).

components.name: Sea-Glass Shamrock
components.description: The one emblem: a single-piece frosted sea-glass shamrock (simplified preview; the build adds edge deepening, leaf light and grain via an SVG filter).

narrative.northStar: Sea Glass on the Drive South
narrative.overview:
Frosted, soft-edged green glass from the Jersey and Florida shores, laid over a still sky. The page ground is one long vertical gradient that starts as a cool New Jersey morning at the top and ends as a warm Florida afternoon at the bottom, so scrolling is the drive south. Content sits on frosted panes that blur the scene behind them and nothing else sits on the ground: no scattered blobs or pebbles of color, so the page stays quiet and expensive. Nothing moves. The glass is felt through translucency, inner shading and green-tinted shadow, never through animation or light effects.

The audience is 40 to 70 and reading on a phone, often inside the Facebook browser. Every rule bends to that: large serif headings, 20px body, 80px call buttons, contrast measured against the actual glass rather than the flat tint, nothing hidden behind a tap or hover. Elegance comes from restraint and material, not from small type or faint text. Density is low: one idea per pane, generous pane padding, a single column on phones.

Confirmed rejections: the dark-hero-plus-white-bands default, every moving glass effect (shimmer, parallax, tilt, animated refraction), glints, specular highlight streaks and rim lines on the glass (removed at Ellie's direction), and eyebrow labels over headings.
keyCharacteristics: Still sky-to-sand ground (sky → mist → shore → sand → sun) behind everything.
Frosted panes: backdrop blur 22px with saturate 150%, tinted aqua → green → peach down the page.
Deep sea-glass green for every call button and for the closing pane.
Gilda Display for headings, numerals and the wordmark; the system sans at 20px for reading.
Brass appears only on numerals and on hover/focus outlines.
One emblem: a single-piece frosted sea-glass shamrock drawn in SVG.

rules.name: The Brass Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Brass appears on numerals and on hover/focus outlines, nowhere else. No brass fills, borders, icons or headings.

rules.name: The Measured on Glass Rule
rules.body: Every text color is checked at 4.5:1 or better against the real rendered glass, not the flat tint. If a pane's tint gets darker, the tint changes; the text never gets lighter.

rules.name: The Green Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is bottle green or ivory. No gray text, no pure black.

rules.name: The Eighteen Floor Rule
rules.body: No reading text below 18px (1.125rem). Body is 20px.

rules.name: The One Weight Serif Rule
rules.body: Gilda Display is used at 400 only. Hierarchy comes from size and color, never from faux bold.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. No small caps kicker, tag or eyebrow label above any heading. Uppercase tracking is reserved for the wordmark and the action word inside a call button.

rules.name: The Green Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted bottle green (rgba 19,70,54 or 11,51,40), soft and long. No black shadows on light glass, no hard offsets.

rules.name: The Still Glass Rule
rules.body: Nothing moves: no transitions, animations, parallax, shimmer or scroll effects. State changes are instant.

rules.name: The No Glint Rule
rules.body: Glass has no specular streaks, glints, highlight strokes or rim lines. Light inside the glass is only ever a diffuse wash.

dos: **Do** keep the ground as the single sky → mist → shore → sand → sun gradient; the scroll is the drive south.
**Do** keep the ground clear: no color blooms, blobs or pebbles behind the panes (Ellie cut them as less elegant).
**Do** tint panes in page order aqua → green → peach and end on the deep sea-glass pane.
**Do** make every call button at least 80px tall (56px absolute minimum) with the full number on it.
**Do** keep body text at 20px and nothing below 18px.
**Do** measure every text color against the rendered glass at 4.5:1 or better; the brass numeral at 4.77:1 is the floor.
**Do** keep tap targets at least 48px tall, including header and footer links.
donts: **Don't** add motion of any kind: no transitions, animated glass, parallax, reveal-on-scroll or hover lifts.
**Don't** hide content behind accordions, tabs, menus, popups or sticky widgets.
**Don't** add glints, specular highlight streaks, highlight strokes or rim lines to panes or the shamrock.
**Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker or tag label above any heading.
**Don't** use brass for text other than numerals, or the lighter outline brass for any text at all.
**Don't** add a second contact action (form, email, text, social); call is the only action.
**Don't** use gray or black text or black shadows; ink and shadow are bottle green.
**Don't** bold Gilda Display or set it below 16px (the phone wordmark size).
